isolation.statement: Fresh round-one classification review used only the authorized workflow, gate files, frozen inventory, candidate inventory, complete transcript and events, manifest, validators, and named audio-verification evidence; no prior semantic review was available.

findings.description: The frozen inventory used broad excerpts that frequently included setup, adjacent propositions, moderator language, or trailing material; the candidate tightens all sixteen selections to bounded single-speaker argumentative acts.

The frozen responsive sample was concentrated in the opening thirty-nine minutes and repeatedly sampled the same exchanges; the candidate replaces later slots with chronologically distributed exchanges through 1:32:53 while retaining every lane and interlocutor quota.

The frozen responsive packets often reduced compound assertions to generic one-component summaries or paired moves with claims they did not specifically answer; the candidate reconstructs exact opponent-owned target claims and indispensable typed components.

The frozen inventory represented every responsive target as a single fact-premise despite expressed comparisons, inferences, burdens, and conclusions; the candidate supplies acyclic node-specific graphs without duplicated component content or contact propagation.

The frozen inventory assigned every selected act to a central bridge and retained routes belonging to displaced speakers; the candidate restores the sampled speaker's side route and uses subsidiary bridges for the narrower doctrinal exchanges in moves 12 through 14.

The frozen move 14 did not lock the latest opponent formulation in the covenant exchange; the candidate targets Hitchens's immediately preceding repeated demand at 37:55 that Kushner state whether God has a special covenant with the Jewish people.

Replacing the frozen moves and their generic pairings materially changed the represented argumentative meaning; the candidate now preserves each selected speaker's actual claim, reply object, and inferential structure across the complete authorized source chain.

repairs.change: Tightened source spans, excerpts, hashes, and selection rationales to isolate one complete argumentative act per selected speaker.
Reselected responsive moves across the full substantive debate while preserving sixteen total moves, four constructives, twelve responses, side minima, and each interlocutor's required coverage.
Rebuilt responsive target packets from exact opponent excerpts with correct targetSpeaker, targetSide, speaker-only ownership, claims, and indispensable components.
Decomposed compound targets into typed premises, comparisons, inferences, burdens, and conclusions with valid acyclic dependencies and no component overlap.
Corrected routes for reselected speakers and assigned subsidiary rather than central bridges to the narrower omnipotence, theology, and covenant exchanges.
Replaced move 14's stale metaphor target with Hitchens's most recent covenant demand at 2275240–2284160 milliseconds and rebuilt the packet as a single burden component.
Replaced generic or mismatched frozen semantic content with transcript-faithful moves and targets whose claims and relations match what the selected speakers actually argued.

nextReviewTrigger.rationale: A second fresh independent semantic review is mandatory for every multi-speaker round-one inventory, and the documented protected-field repairs independently trigger review in each listed category.
